requirements.description: Monthly stock returns, end-of-month price, and shares outstanding for NYSE/AMEX common stocks, May 1962 - April 1995 (formation-date market equity, annual buy-and-hold Year +1..+5 returns, size deciles).
Point-in-time share code (10/11 ordinary common) and exchange code (1 NYSE, 2 AMEX) intervals per permno for the NYSE/AMEX universe filter, active at each end-of-April formation date.
Delisting dates, codes, and delisting returns to implement the paper's treatment of stocks that disappear from CRSP mid-year (replaced with the corresponding size-decile return through year end).

CRSP monthly market indices: value-weighted (vwretd) for Table VIII CAPM betas, equal-weighted (ewretd) for the size-decile benchmarks' cross-check and the Table VII W25/N88/P122/B25 market-state months.

Annual industrial fundamentals for the accounting variables: earnings before extraordinary items (ib), depreciation (dp), sales (sale), book-equity components (ceq, seq, che, at, lt, dlc, dltt, txdb, pstkrv), dividends (dvc), fiscal-year timing (fyear, datadate, fyr), and filters (indfmt, consol, popsrc, datafmt). Fiscal years 1957-1989 cover the 5-year pre-formation windows back to April 1968 formations and the +5 post-formation windows through April 1995.
CRSP-Compustat linking table to join gvkey fundamentals to CRSP permnos point-in-time (primary links, linkprim='P', linktype in LU/LC/LS as per standard CCM usage).
Monthly risk-free rate for excess-return CAPM betas in Table VIII (paper: 'corresponding returns on the value-weighted CRSP index and the risk-free asset', L2342).

notes: All seven data requirements are fully covered by the catalog (crsp_202601, comp_202601, ff). Known scope limitation (not a data blocker): Table VII Panels 2A/2B require quarterly real GNP growth data (BEA), which is not present in ClickHouse; those panels were excluded at Stage 4 (see tables_to_replicate.json table_VII notes) while Panel 1 (market-month states, fully covered by CRSP monthly data) is replicated. Coverage risk flagged for Stage 7: Compustat funda coverage of NYSE/AMEX firms is thin before the 1978 database expansion the paper itself discusses (L118); early formation years (1968-1972) may have fewer firms than the paper's original vintage. This affects sample size, not column availability.
